## Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview API

Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview is a large language model by Google, available on the Venice API as `gemini-3-1-pro-preview`. The provider of this model may retain prompt data (though it is anonymized by Venice). For sensitive content, use a private model.

Gemini 3.1 Pro is an evolution of Google's flagship frontier model with 1M context, advancing high-precision multimodal reasoning across text, image, and code.

### Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gemini-3-1-pro-preview` | Standard | Anonymized | $2.50 / $15.00 per 1M |

### Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Google |
| Released | Feb 19, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Context window | 1M tokens |
| Max output | 32K tokens |
| Reasoning effort | low, medium, high |
| [GPQA Diamond](/models/methodology#benchmarks) | 81.0% ±3.2 (95% interval), run by Venice through the API at its default reasoning on Oct 8, 2026 |
| [Live speed and uptime](/models/methodology#machine-readable-data) | https://metrics.venice.ai/v1/models/gemini-3-1-pro-preview.json, refreshed every 5 minutes |

### How to use the Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "gemini-3-1-pro-preview"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-3-1-pro-preview",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }],
    "reasoning_effort": "low"
  }'
```
